QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) passes the vector through. If no tokenizer is wired, it also returns `{}` silently (line 795)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through the tokenizer's empty `{}` on failure and also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It adds that the two cases "look identical to every caller".
